paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: Different Audio-Language models’ performance on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR.
model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the performance of different audio-language models evaluated across two distinct benchmarks. The horizontal category axis lists three specific models—"Qwen2-Audio-Instruct", "Audio-Reasoner", and "Qwen-2.5-Omni"—arranged in a discrete format without an overall axis label. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and features a linear scale with a range from 0 to 70, displaying numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 10 units. The data is presented using side-by-side grouped bars for each model category. According to the legend in the upper left corner, the solid blue bars represent the "MMAU" benchmark, while the solid light purple bars represent the "MMAR" benchmark. In terms of values, the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct model shows an MMAU accuracy of approximately 49% and an MMAR accuracy of roughly 30%, which is the shortest bar on the chart. For the Audio-Reasoner model, the MMAU bar indicates approximately 61% accuracy, while the paired MMAR bar is at about 36%. The Qwen-2.5-Omni model displays the highest value on the chart with its MMAU bar reaching approximately 65%, accompanied by an MMAR bar at roughly 56%. The model categories along the horizontal axis are not sorted in alphabetical order or by strictly ascending or descending values, and none of the bars feature additional visual emphasis such as outlines, shading, or data annotations.
